description.name: Linked Materia Mode (Fire, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire] after using a Fire ability, grants [Attach Lightning] after using a Lightning ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Elena
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Sparkcharged Bombardment (0~2), removed after using Apex Sparkcharged Bombardment two times

description.name: Apex Sparkcharged Bombardment Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Sparkcharged Bombardment level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Elena]

description.name: Apex Sparkcharged Bombardment Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Sparkcharged Bombardment level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Elena]
